thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `enable_new_routing_v2` tomorrow 15:00 UTC during the quiet window. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m (10m soak each). Who can run smoke and own rollback?

maya: I can own smoke tests and stay on call.

jonathan: I'll push the toggle and watch infra/metrics. Do we have the rollback CLI handy?

sara: Safe default is OFF. Rollback is flipping it back to `off`. Also reminder: traffic fallback routes to `v1` if routing_v2 fails.

alex: Deployment checklist (short):
- infra health green
- KV cache warmed
- no pending migrations/PRs
- smoke owner confirmed
- rollback command and contact list ready
Any blockers?

maya: KV cache ~90% warmed in staging. No migrations. One config PR (PR#542) was pending but merged 10m ago.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle change `enable_new_routing_v2` at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. Rollout steps: 10% @T, 50% @T+10m, 100% @T+20m. Canary region: eu-west1.

jonathan: Suggest we add a lightweight canary request to validate routing: `curl -H "x-tenant: test-tenant" https://api.redwood.ai/route-check` expecting JSON with `"routing_v2": true` in the body for canaryed requests. I'll paste exact command when ready.

sara: Smoke checklist shorthand (what to validate):
1) /health returns 200
2) No 5xxs on /v1/generate or /v1/chat for 10m after each step
3) p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 350ms
4) no cache thrashing / increased egress
Maya to run these.

maya: I'll run smoke and post PASS/FAIL. Quick ops commands I use: `kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=app=routing -o wide` and `curl -sS https://staging.ops.redwood.ai/health | jq .`

alex: Rollback procedure (one-liner + notes):
1) `rwtoggle set enable_new_routing_v2 off --reason "rollback <short-reason>"`
2) revert traffic-router percent rules if you bumped those separately
3) notify infra-oncall + product in #eng-platform and escalate if errors persist
If you need me to execute, ping me and I'll run it.

jonathan: Operational tip: when metrics spike, set toggle to 0% first (quick UI action) then run the `rwtoggle set ... off` to record reason. Also created an alert: page if p95 latency > 400ms for 5m.

maya: I'll be at my desk from T-15m to T+30m and watching metrics.

alex: Last call — any objections to proceeding at 15:00 UTC? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

sara: :thumbsup:

jonathan: :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup: I'll post the canary curl and smoke results once we start.

alex: Great — I'll update the runbook with timestamps, PR links, and the handoff note. Leaving the scheduled job in deploy-bot. Thanks all!
